latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with core daily news features.

- Added news list retrieval via API, supporting specific dates and daily summaries.
- Enabled fetching and viewing detailed news articles by article ID.
- Included sample scripts: get-daily.js (news list) and get-article.js (news detail).
- Supported news category filtering (e.g., politics, technology, finance).
- Provided user-friendly reply templates and error handling guidance.
